name: aerostrat-root
description: Real-time flight radar — live ADS-B tracking with a global map.
author: liawboy

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cd backend && npm start" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "cd backend && npm start" "cd client && npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3005 http://localhost:3000/api/ping && electron ."
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:client && npm run prebuild:electron-data && npm run stage:backend-seed && npm run build:electron:mac
